I am grateful for all the wonderful work that has been done on Voat. As a site that is still growing, there will inevitably be some UI elements that are less successful than others. In my opinion, the "user info" pop-up is one such element.

While it's a nice idea, the user info pop-up (i.e. the one that pops up when you mouseover a username) is not particularly useful, nor needed. Moreover, it interrupts browsing by having something distracting interrupt their focus while readers are scrolling, whenever they accidentally let their mouse linger on a username.

If someone wants to know more about a given user, they will most often click (or CTRL-click) on that user's name. There is little advantage (or need) to have a limited profile pop up so frequently. Moreover, the aforementioned pop-up is both distracting and interrupts regular browsing. It also adds a small, though unnecessary server load by fetching said information. As such, I think it should be removed. At the very least, one should have the option to disable it from their settings.

/old school web 1.0 guy.
